U-0001.summary: Replace the BinaryFormatter deep copy in Book.Snapshot, an error from .NET 8 (SYSLIB0011) that also throws at run time, with a copy of the orders by hand.
review_notes: Snapshot shares the order lines and amounts, which are immutable, and rebuilds each order through its public API, moving it to the same status (Pay, Ship, Cancel).

U-0004.summary: Merge Money.Equals's negated type check and its cast into one pattern (obj is not Money other); Report.Describe's value is Money has no cast after it and stays.

U-0006.summary: Make Book.Import's StringReader a using declaration: only the return follows its block, and disposing a StringReader there changes nothing.

U-0008.summary: Nothing left to change: Report.Skus returns Array.Empty<string>() through IList<string>, where [] would build a mutable List<string> instead of the fixed-size empty array.

U-0009.summary: Make Money and OrderLine records: both compare every field in Equals, which the record now generates; their constructors with validation, GetHashCode and Money's ToString stay as they were.
review_notes: OrderLine had no ToString of its own; as a record it prints its properties (OrderLine { Sku = apple, ... }) instead of its type name. Nothing in the project reads it.
Both types gain value-comparing == and != operators; the project compares them with null only (Report.Table), which keeps its meaning.

U-0010.summary: Enable nullable reference types in the library's files: Book.Get, Order.Total, Order.Find and Order.Note can be null and say so; the rest of each file was already null-safe.
review_notes: Report.Table takes each order with book.Get(id)!: the IDs come from book.Ids(), so every one is in the book.

edits.search:
Order order = book.Get(id);
            Money total = order.Total();
edits.replace:
Order order = book.Get(id)!; // the ID comes from book.Ids()
            Money? total = order.Total();
